retention_rule.all_four_pass: O1 retained; z0 = G0, z1 = O1; latent birth unlocks
retention_rule.any_gate_fails: O1 NOT retained; z1 NOT born
retention_rule.insufficient_support: INSUFFICIENT; rerun with more evaluation seeds, change nothing else
retention_rule.birth_is_separate: Forcing z0 vs z1 must preserve the crossover measured here. Retention does not imply birth.

on_failure.report_as: a failure of this response oracle on this niche
forbidden_responses: retuning thresholds, the step budget, or the injector after seeing results

legitimate_next_moves: a different exposure mechanism (G0-prefix handoff training) under a NEW preregistration
